description:
***COMMUNAL GARDEN AREA***

G1	Hornbeam (Carpinus betulus) Group	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the trees by approximately 2-3m to shape and contain, retaining furnishing growth. Final height = 4m and final spread = 4m.	

G2	Hornbeam (Carpinus betulus) Group	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the trees by approximately 2-3m to shape and contain, retaining furnishing growth. Final height = 4m and final spread = 4m.		

T4	Lombardy Poplar (Populus nigra 'Italica')	Reduce height by approximately 6-7m and sides by approximately 3-4m to rebalance the tree and bring it back to more columnar shape. Final height = 12m and final spread = 6m.	
	
T5	Cherry (Prunus spp)	Crown Lift all round to provide approximately 2m clearance from ground level.	Final height and spread remain unchanged.

GARAGE AREA		

T6	Walnut (Juglans regia)	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 2-3m to rebalance and contain, retaining furnishing growth. Ensure section over neighbours garden and section over garages is sufficiently reduced. Final height = 8m and final spread = 6m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
